prompt: I run outbound for 4 B2B clients. Next month I want to send 60,000 cold emails total (clients get 25k, 15k, 12k, 8k). Last month: 41 domains, 120 inboxes, reply rate fell from 2.1% to 1.2% across the board, and 6 domains got burned. Plan the infrastructure for next month and tell me what to watch.
rubric: Computes inboxes and domains needed from the send target with stated per-inbox/day and per-domain assumptions, and the arithmetic is right
Sets per-domain reply-rate floors and what happens when a domain falls below
Gives a burn-replacement cadence sized to last month's 6 burned domains (warm spares)
Includes a shadow-ban or inbox-placement test and an automation error budget
Splits capacity per client and states which assumptions are its own rather than facts
